provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Asks a warm, familiar yes-no question, typically downward or to an intimate: 元気かい, もう慣れたかい. The sibling lane asks in order to deny and expects no answer: 知るかい, 信じるかい. It follows the plain form but drops だ after a noun or na-adjective (学生かい), questions built on 何・誰・どこ take だい, and かい is old-fashioned today, not used to a superior.

examples.ruby: 明日[あした]の朝[あさ]、一緒[いっしょ]に釣[つ]りに行[い]くかい。
examples.english: Want to come fishing with me tomorrow morning?

examples.ruby: 新[あたら]しい仕事[しごと]にはもう慣[な]れたかい。
examples.english: So, have you settled into the new job yet?

examples.ruby: この写真[しゃしん]に写[うつ]っている人[ひと]は君[きみ]の弟[おとうと]かい。
examples.english: Is the person in this photo your little brother?
